compare.exclude_fields_reason: Cross-language RNG divergence: Python MT vs Rust Xoshiro256++ may resolve intent telegraphing differently even on a single-move self-loop (the engine fires after_intent_chosen hooks that can consume RNG bits). Excluding the intent triple keeps the structural shape-lock independent of those bits while leaving HP/max_hp/pile counts/keys all byte-locked. Parafright's HP is deterministic (rng_range 21..=21) so the initial-state HP is pinned exactly.
